Name: Simple Bigger Farms
Author: llt3
Description:
This mod provides new maps for the Riverland Farm, Forest Farm, and Wilderness Farm. These very lightly edited maps provide slightly more useable or accessible space without enlarging the map area or changing the general characteristics of the map. Perfect for the min/max player who wants a bit more space to work with but doesn't always want to play the Standard Farm.

This mod will conflict with any mod that loads new maps for the Riverland Farm, Forest Farm, or Wilderness Farm. (And Standard Farm if using the XL version.)

It should work with any expansion mods and most other mods because these maps do not change the entrances/exits from the vanilla maps. (XL version change the exits from the Forest to the Farm.)

Version 2.0 adds extra large versions of the Riverland Farm, Forest Farm, Wilderness Farm, and Standard Farm. To use these enormous maps, change the XLMaps option in the config file to true. 

This can be used with an existing save, though you may have stray bushes. (You can use the mod Reset Terrain Features to solve this problem.)

Special Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url], without SMAPI and Content Patcher this mod would not be possible.
